title: The new computer landscape with Apple's M5 and M6 chips
seoTitle: Apple's M5 and M6 Chips: The New Computer Landscape
subtitle: Discover the details about the newly announced processors and features
excerpt: Learn about the new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips, and technical comparisons with M6 technology in processing and artificial intelligence.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Discussion surrounding Apple's new releases is shaking up the tech market following announcements of advanced processors and new artificial intelligence features. The updates detail unprecedented performance capabilities and architectures for professional-grade desktop computers.

Mac Studio performance with M5 Max and M5 Ultra

The new Mac Studio comes equipped with M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips to accelerate professional workflows and artificial intelligence tasks directly on the device. The M5 Max model features an 18-core processor, a graphics card with up to 40 cores and integrated neural accelerators, and up to 128GB of unified memory. Meanwhile, the M5 Ultra version scales up to a 36-core processor, 80 graphics cores, and 512GB of unified memory, enabling the execution of large language models.

Advanced connectivity and wireless network support

The new machines bring updated connection technologies to ensure fast transfers and greater stability. Support for the Thunderbolt 5 standard allows transfer rates of up to 120Gb/s, in addition to enabling the connection of multiple systems in a cluster for distributed computing. The N1 chip introduces support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, offering more reliable and efficient wireless connections.

The architecture and new features of the M6 chip

The M6 introduces a significant architectural change by dividing the processor into three core types, including so-called super-cores for single-threaded workloads. The component also doubles the capacity of the neural engine and adopts an advanced two-nanometer manufacturing process. Compared to the M5, the M6 brings general performance refinements, but the difference in everyday tasks may be hard to notice for most users.

Artificial intelligence integrated into the operating system

The arrival of the macOS system brings enhanced artificial intelligence tools, including the Siri AI assistant. The technology uses personal context to help search for messages, emails, and photos, as well as answering questions and interacting with apps. Additional features assist with navigation organization and advanced image editing.

With information from Apple, MacRumors, Yahoo Finance.
